name: v8_customer_pagerank_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Customer authority worked in v7; PageRank is a related but not identical network-centrality measure. Test whether customer network centrality survives a field change while close/open reversal keeps turnover and correlation controlled.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_page_rank, 60), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Near-family test against RRpmO2xb; submit only if correlation gate passes clearly.

name: v8_competitor_hub_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Competitor graph hub score may capture competitive-network structure rather than customer-network authority. Pair with close/open reversal and a small ROE anchor.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ompetitorgraphrank_hub_rank, 60), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Distinct relationship mechanism from customer authority; watch sub-universe and correlation.

name: v8_news_open_gap_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Opening gaps around news can reflect auction overreaction. Reverse the smoothed gap signal and stabilize it with close/open reversal plus ROE quality.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * nws12_mainz_opengap, 20), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: News gap branch; different from earnings sentiment in RRpmOAWj.

name: v8_news_result_vs_index_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Pure news relative performance failed earlier; reverse the event-relative return and use close/open reversal plus ROE as stabilizers.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * nws12_mainz_result_vs_index, 20), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests whether event-return reversal works after v5 positive news_indx_perf failed.

name: v8_option_pcr_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Option put/call positioning alone was too weak, but a low-weight, smoothed PCR component may add crowding information to the close/open reversal parent.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_oi_all, 60), industry) + 0.45 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Option branch with lower weight; likely high correlation with reversal parent if PCR adds little.

name: v8_option_skew_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Implied-volatility skew was weak alone. A smoothed skew term may proxy downside-demand/crowding when paired with close/open reversal and ROE.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(implied_volatility_mean_skew_60, 60), industry) + 0.45 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Option skew branch; keep only if it improves correlation-adjusted value.
